title: Envelope
description: Canonical message envelope for every channel in docs/PROTOCOL.md.

protocol_version.description: Protocol major version. Unsupported versions fail closed with VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.

request_id.description: Correlates a request with its response.

kind.description: Operation name, for example browser.capture.begin. Each endpoint enforces its own allowlist.

payload.description: Operation-specific payload, validated by the schema for its kind.
